Thanks for starting this. Quick notes from ACE ops and the PDM intake checklist:

- AWS PDM contact for initial intake is pdm-ace-aws@amazon.com (I've added them here). Expect the PDM to ask for:
  * SOC2 Type II report (latest)
  * High-level network diagram and data flow (redacted is fine)
  * Example support SLA and retention policy
  * Product screenshots for listing

- I reviewed Solstice's vendor matrix attached by Meera — looks good; we should still supply a concise evidence bundle: ACE_preflight_notes.docx (I'll draft) + our standard data handling one-pager.

Proposed next steps (short-term):
1) Ben: lock procurement contact/time with Solstice (owner: Ben) — target by 2027-10-09
2) Karthik: prepare model listing screenshots + 1-pager for PDM — target by 2027-10-12
3) Kimberly: assemble evidence bundle and upload to shared Drive, then share link in thread — target by 2027-10-13

If PDM can do a 30-min intro the week of Oct 11, we'll aim for Tue/Wed afternoons PST. Ben, can you confirm availability with Meera/Aaron?
